Subject: POC onramp & MAP items for next 3 weeks

Hi Hannah / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited to move to a short POC to validate latency and cost for our triage workflows. Our security team asked for a concise mutual action plan we can attach to the procurement packet.

Top items they flagged (we can seed these into a MAP):
- Org & tenant creation (who will invite our service accounts)
- API key provisioning and least-privilege scopes
- IP allowlist for the trial endpoints (we have a static egress range)
- VPC peering options (we prefer AWS VPC peering if supported)

Can we get an estimate for the timeline and a primary owner for each item? We want to start environment provisioning by Nov 22 and run a 10-day performance run.

Mike from our infra team will be on the thread for the network bits.

Best,
Priya
Dr. Priya Rao
VP Product, HealthBridge.ai

4) VPC peering / connectivity — Owner: Mike Chen (HealthBridge) + Neha Kapoor (redwood) — Target: Nov 21 (acceptance/handshake)
5) Trial run window — Nov 23–Dec 2 (10 business days)

Action items for this afternoon:
- Priya / Mike: share CIDR egress range and contact for netops (reply with CIDR + contact)
- Ben: draft scoped API key policy (least privilege) and share in thread
- Neha: share preflight checklist for peering (expected port/list) and the VPC template (I attached a lightweight template).
